ITEM 1 | Leafy greens, dark green wilted leaves with crinkled, glossy surfaces and pale stems; interspersed with thin red/magenta stem pieces and a few small yellow-orange pieces; moist, slightly sheen, mounded in a loose pile covering roughly 40% of the plate's area, about 4-5 cm tall in the mound | 150
ITEM 2 | Cooked protein piece, golden-brown seared exterior with flecks of herb visible on top, pale pinkish-white interior, moist, firm, roughly oval chunk about 4 cm long and 2.5 cm wide, sitting on the right side of the plate near the greens | 60
ITEM 3 | Cooked protein piece, golden-brown crusty browned surface with darker charred edges, pale cream interior with flaky texture, irregular chunk about 5 cm by 3 cm and 2 cm tall, sitting at the lower right edge of the plate | 80
ITEM 4 | Scattered crumbs and small browned bits, golden-tan, dry and crumbly, a few small fragments scattered around the protein pieces on the right side of the plate | 10
